task: EPMCDME-13933: Keep marketplace assistant indexing from failing on embedding context length by capping documents with token budgets (tiktoken) in AssistantLoader and adding per-document fallback in the platform processor, so one bad entity is skipped instead of failing the whole index.

component_scope.label: M
component_scope.affected: AssistantLoader (token-budget truncation of description/tools/page_content), BasePlatformDatasourceProcessor (batched _add_documents with per-document fallback, fail_fast for single-entity indexing, skipped-document logging)
component_scope.layers: Service (datasource loader/processor), External (embedding model + Elasticsearch vector store)

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Minor: token budget values (2000/500/4000) and the skip-on-failure versus fail-fast split for single-entity indexing were implementation decisions; review round surfaced one major finding (CR-001) that needed a fix

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: New token-based truncation (tiktoken o200k_base, multi-byte decode trim loop), changed error semantics in shared base processor (batch failure now retries per document and skips silently-logged failures), base class shared by all platform processors (assistants, workflows, datasources), logging bug with reserved LogRecord 'name' key found in review
technical_risk.mitigation: Cached encoding via lru_cache, update/single-entity paths keep fail-fast error propagation, skipped documents logged with entity id, dedicated resilience tests in test_base_platform_processor.py and truncation tests in test_assistant_loader.py

key_reasoning.reason: Two components in the datasource subsystem changed: AssistantLoader page-content building and the shared BasePlatformDatasourceProcessor indexing path, which is inherited by every platform datasource processor.

No exact precedent for token-budget truncation in the loader, and the base processor's failure semantics changed from fail-whole-batch to retry-per-document-and-skip. Review found a major issue (CR-001) and a reserved LogRecord 'name' key bug, both fixed. Still within M: non-critical path, easy to roll back.
4 files (2 source, 2 test, one test file new). 364 insertions, mostly test coverage.
No dependency manifest changed. tiktoken, an existing library, is used in a new place.
